# Williams Digital

> Birmingham, Alabama web design and software studio run by Dylan Williams (Auburn University, Computer Science). Builds custom websites, business dashboards, client portals, ecommerce stores, and web/iOS apps for small businesses and organizations.

Contact: Dylan@williamsdigital.io · (205) 202-9193 · https://williamsdigital.io/start.html

## Services
- [Website design](https://williamsdigital.io/services/website-design/): Custom-designed, hand-coded sites that load fast, rank locally, and turn visitors into calls and bookings.
- [Custom dashboards](https://williamsdigital.io/services/custom-dashboards/): The back office your team actually uses — leads, jobs, bookings, customers, and revenue in one screen.
- [Client portals](https://williamsdigital.io/services/client-portals/): Secure logins where your customers track progress, share files, approve work, and pay.
- [Ecommerce](https://williamsdigital.io/services/ecommerce-websites/): Online stores with Stripe Checkout, sales tax, pickup or shipping — and a catalog you manage yourself.
- [Apps & platforms](https://williamsdigital.io/services/app-development/): Directories, marketplaces, booking systems, SaaS, and iOS apps — taken from idea to launch.
- [Municipal & community](https://williamsdigital.io/services/municipal-website-design/): Accessible, mobile-first sites for towns and communities — events, documents, forms, and staff publishing.

## Live work
- [Ridgepole](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/ridgepole/) (SaaS product, https://ridgepole.io): The operating system for contractors and home builders — jobs, builds, schedules, change orders, and a client portal.
- [Canvas Sports](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/canvas-sports/) (SaaS product, https://canvassports.app): The operating system for local sports organizations — programs, registration, teams, game day, and verified scores.
- [WeAddALogo](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/weaddalogo/) (Client ecommerce, https://weaddalogo.com): Custom embroidery and DTF printing in Leeds, Alabama — Stripe storefront plus custom-order quotes.
- [Buy Auburn](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/buy-auburn/) (Client platform, https://buyauburn.com): A national directory of Auburn-owned businesses with applications, approvals, and subscription billing.
- [Milestone Journey+](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/milestone-journey/) (iOS app · our product, https://milestonejourney.app): A baby tracker for feedings, sleep, diapers, milestones, and growth — live on the App Store.
- [Vardar Transportation](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/vardar-transportation/) (Client website + dashboard, https://vardartransportation.com): Luxury van rentals and chauffeured travel in Birmingham — booking requests plus an owner dashboard.
- [Steve R. Skipper Studio](https://williamsdigital.io/portfolio/steve-skipper-studio/) (Client website, https://steveskipperstudio.com): A gallery-first home for an internationally recognized sports, faith, and portrait artist.

## Pricing
- Business website: from $2,500 one-time
- Website + dashboard: from $5,000 one-time
- Custom platform: from $10,000 fixed quote after a scoping call
- Site care: $50/month
- Site + dashboard care: $100/month
- Platform care: $250/month
